updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Microsoft 365 Copilot in SharePoint Online

User impact: Users may be unable to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online.

More info: When users attempt to create a SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online, they may receive an error that states, “We couldn't verify your license.”

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Microsoft 365 Copilot in SharePoint Online

User impact: Users may be unable to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online.

More info: When users attempt to create a SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online, they may receive an error that states, “We couldn't verify your license.”

Current status: We're reviewing the HTTP Archive format (HAR) logs provided by a subset of affected users to isolate the source of the error and determine the reason users can't create SharePoint knowledge agents.

Scope of impact: Any user attempting to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, October 16, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Microsoft 365 Copilot in SharePoint Online

User impact: Users may be unable to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online.

More info: When users attempt to create a SharePoint knowledge agent using Copilot in SharePoint Online, they may receive an error that states, “We couldn't verify your license.”

Current status: We've identified that a recent service change had a missing configuration that's preventing the licensing from being fetched and validated. We're developing a fix to add the missing configuration and remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: Any user attempting to create SharePoint knowledge agents using Copilot in SharePoint Online may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A recent service change had a missing configuration that's preventing the licensing from being fetched and validated, causing impact.
